**STEP 3 - Items:** Cooked, crispy pan-fried bacon strips, piled in the center. No visible oil or sauce pooling.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The bacon covers about 30% of the plate, roughly 159 cm².

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The strips are thin, flat, and overlapping, so the pile is about 0.7 cm high on average. 159 cm² × 0.7 cm ≈ 111 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Crisp, irregular bacon pieces are airy, so I use a bulk density of about 0.7 g/ml rather than the solid-meat value. 111 ml × 0.7 ≈ 78 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Pan-fried bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g. 78 g × 5.4 ≈ 420 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 78 g corresponds to roughly 8–10 cooked strips, which matches the visible pile. A bacon-only plate of this size is plausible.

**Estimate:** about 78 g of bacon, about 420 kcal.
